comments.author: participant1
comments.body: The starship initialization is less sticky than that of some other prompts. Please try disabling your other shell theme by running `prompt off` or commenting/removing the `ZSH_THEME="powerlevel10k/powerlevel10k"` and `[[ ! -f ~/.p10k.zsh ]] || source ~/.p10k.zsh` parts of your `.zshrc`.

comments.body: Warp uses its own built-in prompt, and custom prompts like starship only work when support for that is enabled in the warp settings.
